verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a platform like Temporal, which exposes client and SDK APIs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference or runnable examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the llms.txt documentation index and CLI docs are adjacent features, not an interactive API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
